title: What Each Extra Day Is Charged At on an Equipment Rental and Demo Extension
content:
Where the hire rate for an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement already stands on its rental account, the shop has a better figure for what the guest is paying a day than any rate card carries, and the extra days follow it.

## The rule

Where the rental account carries the hire rate for the agreement, and the agreement was written for at least the package's multi-day threshold in days, each extra day is charged at the hire rate standing on the account divided by the days the agreement was written for, rounded half up to two decimal places.

Where the rental account carries the hire rate for the agreement and the agreement was written for fewer days than the package's multi-day threshold, each extra day is charged at the package's shop day rate.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Multi-day threshold, days | Shop day rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 32.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 46.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 62.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 79.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 2 | 95.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 1 | 0.00 USD |

## The two conditions in combination

| Hire rate standing on the rental account | Days the agreement was written for | Each extra day charged at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| some | at least the package's threshold | the hire rate standing, divided by the days the agreement was written for |
| some | fewer than the package's threshold | the package's shop day rate |
| none | either way | nothing under this heading changes it |

Where the account carries no hire rate at all, neither row is reached.

## Worked figures on hypothetical agreements

Take the Basic Ski & Board Rental, whose threshold is 3 days and whose shop day rate is 46.00 USD.

- The agreement was written for 5 days and its rental account carries a hire rate of 195.00 USD: each extra day is charged at 195.00 USD divided by 5 days, which is 39.00 USD.
- The agreement was written for 2 days and its rental account carries a hire rate of 92.00 USD: 2 days is fewer than the threshold of 3, so each extra day is charged at 46.00 USD.
- The agreement's rental account carries no hire rate: nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

Where the division does not come out to whole cents it is rounded half up to two decimal places: a hire rate of 200.00 USD divided by 3 days gives 66.67 USD.

## Point of judgement

**Which day count the hire rate is divided by.** The days the agreement was written for, not the extra days asked for and not the dates the account shows the kit out.
